data.narrative:
Dusty Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tessa Lau and Philipp Herget that has raised $70M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public company (277810.KQ), including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables—only one same-stage Seed peer exists in the robotics sector, below the three-datapoint minimum required for reliable triangulation. Accordingly, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. Using a $4M total-raised proxy as the base value yields an implied valuation of $9M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7M to $10M, with a median of $9M. The primary uncertainty stems from the sparse Seed-stage peer set in robotics; a broader next-stage comparable analysis would strengthen confidence in the step-up multiplier. Additionally, the recent large capital raise ($70M+) suggests the company may already have progressed beyond traditional Seed metrics, introducing potential timing mismatch between the base valuation proxy and current operational stage.
